scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.jsonc --local --persist-to ./.wrangler/state
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.jsonc --remote
scripts.d1:seed:local: bun run d1:seed:sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --config wrangler.jsonc --local --persist-to ./.wrangler/state --file ./.wrangler/tmp/admin-seed.sql
scripts.d1:seed:remote: bun run d1:seed:sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --config wrangler.jsonc --remote --file ./.wrangler/tmp/admin-seed.sql
scripts.data:bootstrap:local: bun run d1:migrate:local && bun run d1:seed:local && bun run r2:sync:local
scripts.data:bootstrap:remote: bun run d1:migrate:remote && bun run d1:seed:remote && bun run r2:sync:remote
